name: 16506 · Erie, PA
findings: ZIP 16506 (Erie) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16506 (Erie) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16506 (Erie) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
